_doc: [drones] Robot Builder parts. Five slots per robot; 'stock' (no entry) keeps the Mk tier's own look and stats. mods are multipliers on generic stats: speed, load (hopper capacity / fork carry / water tank), work (scoop / plant / spray / refill rate), quality (cube efficiency), reach (spray radius), scan (chance to spot salvage while working). Every non-cosmetic part has at least one upside and one downside (gentle: specialised, not strictly better). source: craft (bolts + one stored part of a type, optional cubes), haggle (Haggle's rotating builder stall: cubes + bolts), token (contract token shop), research (unlock node, then craft), drop (rare finds), set (Maker Fragments + a Vintage-or-better part). roles: which crews a tool fits (multibots take any tool).

salvage._doc: Working robots spot salvage now and then: chance per second = base * scan. A find is a stored part (mostly Rusty/Worn); 1 in fragment_one_in is a Maker Fragment.

haggle._doc: Haggle's builder stall: `offers` haggle-source parts, reshuffled every `rotate_s` seconds of play.

set_bonus.name: Maker Resonance
set_bonus.desc: All three Maker parts fitted: +5% speed, +6% work.

parts.name: Light Frame
parts.desc: Slim exposed rails instead of a full shell.

parts.name: Cargo Hull
parts.desc: Thick side plates and a rear rack. Holds more, drives heavier.

parts.name: Sealed Shell
parts.desc: Smooth covers keep grit out of the compactor. Fussier to service.

parts.name: Maker Shell
parts.desc: Pearl fairings with gold trim, as the Makers built them. Part of the Maker set.

parts.name: Big-Eye Sensor
parts.desc: A huge lens. Spots salvage from far off, gets a little distracted.

parts.name: Focus Visor
parts.desc: Blinkers for robots. Works faster, notices less.

parts.name: Periscope
parts.desc: Sees over the plants: wider spray, slower to turn.

parts.name: Chatterbox Dome
parts.desc: Glass dome with a speaker. Gossips about junk, finds a bit more of it.

parts.name: Maker Optic
parts.desc: A floating gem lens under a gold brow. Part of the Maker set.

parts.name: Treads
parts.desc: Rubber tracks. Carries more, rolls slower.

parts.name: Quad Rotor
parts.desc: Four ducted fans. Quick, but every kilo counts.

parts.name: Walker Legs
parts.desc: Four careful legs. A steady platform for the arm.

parts.name: Hover Skirt
parts.desc: A cushion of air. Glides fast, shakes the hopper.

parts.name: Maker Glider
parts.desc: Twin levitation pods with a thin light seam. Part of the Maker set.

parts.name: Wide Scoop
parts.desc: Grabs more per pass, picks up some grit too.

parts.name: Fine Sieve
parts.desc: Shakes the dirt out: cleaner cubes, slower scooping.

parts.name: Long Forks
parts.desc: Room for one more bale. Wobbly at speed.

parts.name: Tow Hook
parts.desc: Winch and hook: drags bales quickly, eyes on the hook.

parts.name: Seed Drill
parts.desc: An auger that plants fast. Heavy on the nose.

parts.name: Mist Sprayer
parts.desc: Fan nozzle: waters a wider circle, empties the tank sooner.

parts.name: Jet Nozzle
parts.desc: Strong straight jet: quicker watering, narrower spray.

parts.name: Bulb Antenna
parts.desc: A springy antenna with a soft glowing bulb.

parts.name: Tiny Top Hat
parts.desc: For the robot who means business.

parts.name: Crew Flag
parts.desc: A little flag in the crew's colour.

parts.name: Bobble Plant
parts.desc: A sprout on a spring. Boings when it brakes.

source.hint: Haggle's welcome gift with your first robot

parts.name: Traffic Cone
parts.desc: Found it, kept it, wears it.

parts.name: Propeller Cap
parts.desc: Spins when it hurries. Does not help.

parts.name: Lucky Clover
parts.desc: A four-leaf clover that floats. Rare: a robot has to spot one.

source.hint: Rare salvage find (robots with a good Scan)

parts.name: Maker Crest
parts.desc: A floating gold ring. Purely for show; the Makers loved a show.

traits.name: Speedy
traits.desc: Always in a hurry, sometimes a messy one.

traits.name: Chatty
traits.desc: Beeps at everything. Mostly at you.

traits.name: Tidy
traits.desc: Shakes the dust off after every job.

traits.name: Curious
traits.desc: Tilts its head at butterflies and bottle caps.

traits.name: Hummer
traits.desc: Hums little tunes while it works.
